item.description:
BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’ IN GOYANG [D-2] (1080p HD)​


​
The ARIRANG WORLD TOUR is the fourth concert tour by the South Korean boy band BTS, in support of their 2026 studio album, ARIRANG. The tour began on April 9, 2026, in Goyang and continue through 2027. Marking BTS's return to live performances after completing their mandatory military service, it spans more than 85 dates in 34 cities across 23 countries.
